name: Nora Dantes
source:
Your mother, a quick tempered but caring woman who raised [url=https://vndb.org/c148150]you[/url]. Your relationship has been turbulent with her after your [url=https://vndb.org/c148155]father[/url]'s death, with the two of you frequently butting heads. Though perhaps your time away has changed her...
